questions.question: Mock (system design): 1000+ dasturchi uchun global scale qiladigan ephemeral CI/CD platformani loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: 1000 dasturchi, 300 mikroservis, kuniga 20 000 build. Build'lar sekin, runner navbatlari to'lib ketyapti.

questions.question: Mock (system design): to'lovlar uchun zero-downtime, multi-region Kubernetes platformasini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: us-east-1 va eu-west-1, mijozga sezilmaydigan downtime, qat'iy ACID, < 200ms latency.

questions.question: Mock (system design): self-service cloud infra'li Internal Developer Platform (IDP) loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: Dasturchilar DB va IAM role uchun DBA/DevOps'ni haftalab kutadi. Self-service "platform as a product" kerak.

questions.question: Mock (system design): 50 mustaqil jamoa uchun multi-tenant Kubernetes klaster loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: Qat'iy xavfsizlik izolyatsiyasi, adolatli resurs taqsimoti va jamoalar orasida lateral tarmoq kirishi yo'q.

questions.question: Mock (system design): FinTech core banking uchun zero-trust cloud arxitekturasini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: PCI-DSS Level 1 va SOC2 Type II; ichki tarmoq ishonchsiz deb hisoblanadi.

questions.question: Mock (system design): kuniga 50TB log qabul qiladigan real-time log analitika pipeline'ini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: Soniyasiga 500 000 log event, 5 soniyadan kam qidiruv kechikishi, 1 yillik compliance retention.

questions.question: Mock (system design): RPO < 10s va RTO < 2 daqiqa bo'lgan DR failover tizimini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: E-commerce platforma uchun AWS primary va secondary region'lar bo'ylab avtomatik DR.

questions.question: Mock (system design): cloud xarajatini 60% kamaytiradigan Kubernetes platformani loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: Bo'sh over-provisioning sabab Kubernetes hisobi oyiga $200,000.

questions.question: Mock (system design): SLSA Level 3 ga mos xavfsiz software supply chain loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: 500 repo bo'ylab zararli kod kiritish, dependency buzish va ruxsatsiz build'larning oldini olish.

questions.question: Mock (system design): yuqori mavjud multi-region Redis cache qatlamini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: Ijtimoiy tarmoq uchun AQSh va Yevropa bo'ylab < 5ms o'qish latency.

questions.question: Mock (system design): GitOps asosidagi multi-cluster deploy platformasini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: Dev, staging, prod bo'ylab 100 klasterni bitta deklarativ control plane'dan boshqarish.

questions.question: Mock (system design): cloud infra uchun zero-trust developer access gateway loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: 200 muhandis uchun umumiy SSH kalit, VPN va statik DB parollarini xavfsiz, audit qilinadigan modelga almashtirish.

questions.question: Mock (system design): kuniga 100M event'ni qayta ishlaydigan serverless event-driven pipeline loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: IoT telemetriya, o'zgaruvchan burst'lar, server boshqaruvi yo'q.

questions.question: Mock (system design): DDoS'ga chidamli global Anycast tarmoq arxitekturasini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: Korporativ web platformani 1 Tbps L3/L4 va L7 hajmli DDoS'dan himoyalash.

questions.question: Mock (system design): end-to-end mTLS'li service mesh loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: 80 mikroservisda kod o'zgartirmasdan zero-trust mTLS, trafik bo'lish va distributed tracing.

questions.question: Mock (system design): AWS va Google Cloud bo'ylab multi-cloud DR strategiyasini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: Asosiy provayder (AWS) butunlay ishdan chiqsa ham biznes davom etsin.

questions.question: Mock (system design): metrika, log va trace'larni bog'laydigan enterprise observability platformasini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: 5 ta alohida monitoring tool'ini olib tashlab, 200 mikroservis uchun yagona stack qurish.

questions.question: Mock (system design): mikroservis DB migratsiyasini mijozga downtime'siz qanday qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Shart: Soniyasiga 5000 tranzaksiyali 2TB PostgreSQL'ni on-prem'dan Aurora'ga ma'lumot yo'qotmasdan ko'chirish.

questions.question: Mock (system design): 100M foydalanuvchi uchun avtomatik DB sharding arxitekturasini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: Bitta relational DB yozish IOPS chegarasida.

questions.question: Mock (system design): 500 ta DB uchun avtomatik secret rotation pipeline'ini loyihalang.
questions.explanation: Shart: 500 relational DB'da statik parollarni yo'qotish va har 30 kunda downtime'siz rotatsiya.
